title: Every New Truck Coming in 2027 (One Just Got Delayed Again)
description:
Every major new pickup coming for 2027, what is confirmed and what is not: the redesigned Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra with new V8s, the 777-hp Ram Rumble Bee SRT, the return of the Ram Dakota, Ford's Fathom EV and extended-range F-150, the Tundra TRD Pro, the $24,950 Slate and Scout's delay. Every fact comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:35 2027 Chevrolet Silverado
4:04 2027 GMC Sierra
7:18 Ram Rumble Bee SRT and Dakota
9:42 Ford Fathom and F-150 EREV
13:28 Toyota and Honda
14:29 The $24,950 Slate
16:28 Scout's delay
18:38 What it means for buyers
20:23 The verdict

Sources:
- Motor Illustrated, 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 debut (June 2026): https://motorillustrated.com/?p=186867
- AOL, next-gen Silverado and Sierra will arrive this year, GM confirms: https://www.aol.com/articles/next-gen-chevy-silverado-gmc-184200330.html

- AutoGuide, under the 2027 GMC Sierra's hood (Sept 22, 2026): https://www.autoguide.com/auto/manufacturers/gmc/under-the-2027-gmc-sierra-s-hood-four-engines-10-speeds-standard-44639005
- SlashGear, 5 pickup trucks that made a splash in 2026 (Aug 15, 2026): https://www.slashgear.com/2235458/pickup-truck-made-splash-2026/
- Auto123, Ram Dakota returns (Dec 19, 2025): https://www.auto123.com/en/news/ram-dakota-midsize-truck-return-2027/73512/

- Equipment World, Ford's 2027 midsize electric pickup (Aug 2025): https://www.equipmentworld.com/trucks/pickups/article/15752792/fords-new-2027-midsize-electric-pickup-with-30k-start-price
